cohort: Women with a live inpatient delivery in 2016 in the MarketScan databases for commercially insured and Medicaid populations
finding: Cesarean delivery, multifetal gestation, race, region, and several pre-existing comorbidities and obstetric complications were associated with an increased risk of SMM.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with SMM in both commercially insured and Medicaid populations.
